page.layout: One column of numbered entries, each with an italic lead phrase and a scripture reference. Running head and page number at the top. Vertical side-title "IESVITARVM" in the left margin.

main_text.p: Ementitum nomen speciosum, vt facilius fedu-cant ] Multi venient in nomine meo, dicentes, Ego sum Christus, multosq; seducet. Matt.24,5.
Erroris efficacia ] Edent signa magna & mira-cula: ita vt seducant (si fieri possit) etiam ele-ctos. Matt.24,24.
Ostentatio ridicula ] Diligunt primum confes-sum in conventibus & salutatiores [?] in foris. Luc.11,43.
Fraus latens ] Sunt veluti monumenta quæ non apparent, & quæ nesciunt ii, qui super ea ambulant. Luc.11,44.
Insanabilis peruicacia ] Si cæci essetis non haberetis peccatum: nunc vero dicitis, videmus: itaq; peccatum vestrum manet. Ioh.9,41.
Superbia ]Dilexerunt gloriam hominum potius quàm gloriam Dei. Ioh.12,43.
Desperata rebellio ]Duri ceruice, & incircum-cisi corde & auribus, vos semper Spiritui San-cto obnitimini: sicut patres vestri, ita & vos. Actor.7,51.
Vna effigies ]Domino nostro Iesu Christo non seruiunt, sed suo vētri: & per blandiloquentiā, & assentationē hominum corda minime malo-rum.

page.notes: Side-title IESVITARVM in the left margin is printed vertically; recorded as a margin note. Uncertain readings: "salutatiores" (marked [?]) and the lead word of XXXVII, read as "Vna" but possibly "Vina". Long s normalised to plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules. The printed "Infanabilis" was read as "Insanabilis" (long s). Reference "Actor" is partly obscured. Ornamental marks in the left margin (bullets and a small glyph) are not text and are omitted. Lines run to the bottom edge of the scan, and the final word "rum." is printed at the right edge.
